senses.gloss:
भैषजं [भेषजमेव स्वार्थे अण्] A
medicine, drug.
--जः The bird called
लावक or quail.

भैषज्यं [भिषजः कर्म, भेषज-स्वार्थे वा
ष्यञ्]
1 Administering medicines,
medical treatment.
--2 A
medicament, medicine, drug.
--3 Healing
power, curativeness.

भैष्मकी A patronymic of
Rukmiṇī, daughter of Bhīṣmaka of
Vidarbha.
